_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Experimental Paper (Field Trial Data). Uses OTDR/phi-OTDR for Co-Route Fiber Recognition and Vibration Event Classification in 6G Transport Networks using ML.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: ISAC Architecture. Fig 3: OTDR/phi-OTDR Principle. Fig 6-13: ML Performance (Confusion Matrices, Feature Visualization).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: ISAC in Transport Network. Sensing: OTDR (Static) + phi-OTDR (Dynamic). Comm: Existing traffic. Method: ML-based Feature Extraction (FEA-TFW) and Classification.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Co-cable Acc: 99.7%. Co-trench Acc: 97.7%. Vibration Acc: 98%. Benchmarked against SVM/CNN baselines.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Focuses on network survivability and maintenance using ISAC. Uses live operator network data for training, high practical relevance.

bibliographic.title: Co-Route Fiber Recognition and Status Diagnosis Based on Integrated Sensing and Communication in 6G Transport Networks
bibliographic.authors: Zhiwei Wang, Hui Yang, Yunbo Li, Qiuyan Yao, Tiankuo Yu, Chen Zhang, Wenxin Liu, Wenbo Lin, Jie Zhang, Yucong Liu, Mohamed Cheriet

application.scenario_description: Online discernment of co-cable fibers, characterization of fiber optic trenches, and real-time classification of fiber vibration events using ISAC.

key_contribution.key_contribution: ISAC architecture for co-route fiber recognition and vibration diagnosis using FEA-TFW and ML.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Risk of service disruption in co-route fibers and lack of real-time warning for sudden fiber interruptions.

transmitter.notes: Linewidth Tunable Light Source (LTLS) used for OTDR/phi-OTDR.

receiver.notes: Coherent detection for phi-OTDR phase recovery.

integration.notes: Sensing signals share the fiber with communication signals (WDM).

channel_fibre.notes: Uses Rayleigh/Fresnel for OTDR and Rayleigh Phase for phi-OTDR. Live operator network fibers.

comm_metrics.notes: Focus on Sensing/Network Maintenance tasks. Comm assumed active but metrics not primary.

sensing_metrics.notes: Co-cable Acc: 99.7%, Co-trench Acc: 97.7%, Vibration Event Acc: 98%. Spatial res 3.2m.

tradeoff.notes: ML models optimized for real-time response.
